note: Declared LLM call sites. This project has no single wrapper: at least four independent CLI-spawn implementations coexist (engine/src/cli_process.rs CliProcessDriver, companion/brain/oneshot.rs call_claude_text, commands/credentials/ai_artifact_flow.rs spawn_claude_and_collect), plus ad-hoc duplicates (engine/memory_reflection.rs, build_session/fix_pass.rs), a fleet PTY/headless/external path, a raw-HTTP BYOM path (engine/http_engine/), and an Ollama MCP delegate (mcp_server/tools.rs). `records_spend` marks whether a site's cost reaches a persistent, queryable ledger (llm_spend/dev_llm_spend, companion_turn, or the execution/provider_audit tables written by engine/runner) versus being computed and discarded, or never captured at all. Telemetry is local-only today - no external sink.

use_cases.name: Persona/task execution
use_cases.description: Runs a persona's configured task/turn to completion via whichever engine (CLI or HTTP) it is routed to.

use_cases.name: BYOM streaming completion
use_cases.description: Generates a plain streamed text completion against an OpenAI-compatible BYOM endpoint when a persona is routed off the Claude CLI.
use_cases.note: cost_usd is computed here from price_per_million and handed back to runner::run_execution, which persists it into the execution row and provider_audit - not written directly to llm_spend.

use_cases.name: BYOM agentic tool loop
use_cases.description: Runs a multi-turn tool-calling loop against a BYOM endpoint on behalf of a persona execution.

use_cases.name: Companion memory consolidation
use_cases.description: Synthesizes a persona's raw episodic material into durable memory rows during the companion's backend maintenance cycle.

use_cases.name: Companion reflection
use_cases.description: Produces higher-level insight text from a persona's recent memories/interactions.

use_cases.name: Memory reflection engine (legacy duplicate)
use_cases.description: A second, independently-implemented memory-clustering/synthesis pass (Memory Engine v2's ad-hoc CLI spawn) that bypasses the oneshot.rs chokepoint entirely - the same purpose as brain.reflection, on a different, dark code path.
use_cases.note: No observe_line/SpendCtx/companion_turn call anywhere in this file - spawns the CLI ad-hoc (mirrors, but does not use, cli_process.rs) and records no cost at all.

use_cases.name: Companion recall synthesis
use_cases.description: Synthesizes a retrieval-time summary over recalled memory candidates for the companion's vector-search lane.
use_cases.note: feature-gated cfg(ml), dead code on the shipping build (no ml feature) - so this leg never actually runs today even though the wrapper it uses meters correctly when compiled.

use_cases.name: Companion briefing
use_cases.description: Produces the companion's periodic natural-language briefing summary for the user.

use_cases.name: Sleep cycle compression
use_cases.description: Phase A of the nightly sleep cycle: compresses a persona's conversation history into candidate facts/procedurals.

use_cases.name: Sleep cycle reconciliation
use_cases.description: Phase B of the nightly sleep cycle: judges supersession/contradiction over the active fact set produced by compression.

use_cases.name: Night planner
use_cases.description: Plans the companion's unattended overnight work agenda for a persona.

use_cases.name: Night unattended decision
use_cases.description: Judges/decides on planned overnight actions without a human in the loop.

use_cases.name: Companion tours generation
use_cases.description: Generates guided-tour copy for the companion UI.

use_cases.name: Build session resolution turn
use_cases.description: Runs an agentic build-session turn that resolves a build task's next step.

use_cases.name: Build session fix pass
use_cases.description: Ad-hoc CLI spawn that asks the model to correct a failing agent_ir during a build session.
use_cases.note: independent ad-hoc spawn (not cli_process.rs, not oneshot.rs), but still books through record_build_spend.

use_cases.name: Build session tool test
use_cases.description: Exercises a persona's declared tools against live connectors during a build session's test pass.

use_cases.name: Build session test summary
use_cases.description: Summarizes a build session's tool-test results into a short human-readable readout.

use_cases.name: Fleet interactive agent session
use_cases.description: Drives an interactive PTY-attached Claude Code session for a fleet-managed project.
use_cases.note: no observe_line/SpendCtx/companion_turn write in this file; only session-state upserts (record_session_event) are recorded.

use_cases.name: Fleet headless agent session
use_cases.description: Drives a non-interactive, headless Claude Code run for a fleet-managed project.

use_cases.name: Fleet external agent session
use_cases.description: Attaches to/drives an externally-launched agent session on a fleet-managed machine.

use_cases.name: n8n workflow transform
use_cases.description: Transforms/generates an n8n workflow definition from a user prompt via a dedicated CLI runner.
use_cases.note: spawns and streams its own Command directly; no observe_line/SpendCtx/record_build_spend call in this file or in any of its callers (smart_search.rs and team_synthesis.rs only reuse its JSON-extraction helper, not its spawn).

use_cases.name: Repository standards scan
use_cases.description: Scans a project's codebase against standards/rules and extracts findings.

use_cases.name: AI artifact generation (tracked)
use_cases.description: Generates a credential/API-integration artifact (schema, healthcheck, step-help, etc.) via the shared headless spawn helper, with spend recorded.

use_cases.name: Team synthesis
use_cases.description: Given a natural-language query (or a project's dev context, for Crew Foundry), selects and assembles matching persona templates into a new team with wired handoffs.
use_cases.note: Merged with the 'commands.teams.synthesize' site named in the original audit list: commands/teams/teams.rs has no LLM call of its own (execute_team only orchestrates the persona pipeline via engine::pipeline_executor, which is runner.persona_execution per member) - the one Claude call for team synthesis lives entirely in design/team_synthesis.rs and is tracked via run_claude_prompt_tracked.

use_cases.name: Web content extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured data from scraped web page content.
use_cases.note: calls ai_artifact_flow::spawn_claude_and_collect (the untracked variant) directly, not run_claude_prompt_tracked - no observe_line/SpendCtx in this file.

use_cases.name: Automated credential foraging (browser agent)
use_cases.description: Drives a browser-automation agent loop (Playwright MCP) to discover/forage credentials for a connector.
use_cases.note: calls ai_artifact_flow::spawn_claude_and_collect directly (not the *_tracked variant) - no observe_line/SpendCtx in this file.

use_cases.name: MCP LLM delegate offload
use_cases.description: Offloads a text-processing subtask from an agent to a local/self-hosted Ollama-compatible model over the MCP server, to save the calling agent's own budget.
use_cases.note: raw reqwest call to a local Ollama-shaped endpoint; no cost/spend recording of any kind (by design - it targets self-hosted models with no metered price).

use_cases.name: Twin content generation
use_cases.description: Generates/audits a persona's public-facing 'twin' bio and wiki content, and ingests external URLs into pending twin memories.
use_cases.note: calls engine::cli_process::spawn_headless_claude directly; no observe_line/SpendCtx/companion_turn write anywhere in this file - dark.

use_cases.name: Repository idea scan
use_cases.description: Scans a project's codebase to extract candidate improvement/feature ideas.

use_cases.name: Project context generation
use_cases.description: Generates project documentation/context artifacts by exploring a repository with the CLI.
